user.title: Select Powerpal BLE device
user.description: Select a detected {scan_type} device, then enter the pairing details. If the Powerpal app is connected, turn off Bluetooth on that phone or close the app while setting this up. If your Powerpal is not listed, choose manual entry.

setup.title: Powerpal BLE
setup.description: Connect Home Assistant directly to a Powerpal over Bluetooth LE. Turn off the Powerpal mobile app/Bluetooth connection while setting this up. If the address was discovered, it has been pre-filled below.

manual.title: Powerpal BLE manual setup
manual.description: Enter the Powerpal Bluetooth MAC address and pairing details. Turn off the Powerpal mobile app/Bluetooth connection while setting this up.

error.invalid_address: Use a Bluetooth MAC address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_pairing_code: Use the numeric pairing code printed in your Powerpal pack or shown in the Powerpal app.

abort.not_connectable: This Powerpal was only seen by a non-connectable Bluetooth adapter/proxy.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device does not look like a supported Powerpal.

init.title: Powerpal BLE options
init.description: Changing options reloads the integration and reconnects to the Powerpal.
